name: 400 kW fan-wall air handler
summary: Large chilled-water fan-wall air handler of about 400 kW for air-cooled or hybrid halls.

capacityW.note: Class rating for fan-wall units, about twice the largest perimeter CRAH (Vertiv Liebert PCW tops out near 210 kW).

fanPowerW.note: Specific fan power of 0.8 kW per m³/s × 27.6 m³/s = 22 kW, about 5.5 % of capacity.

capexUsd.note: About 350 USD per kW (judgment, economy of scale against the 200 kW unit), equipment only.

leadTimeWeeks.note: Judgment: fan walls are often built to order, so they queue longer than perimeter CRAHs.
